name: seo
summary: Canonical discipline for evidence-backed SEO work across technical audits, page audits, keyword and SERP research, local SEO, schema, AI search, content briefs, drift checks, and reporting.
blocking_rules: Do not present SEO scores, estimates, or provider metrics as ranking, traffic, indexing, or AI-citation guarantees.
Do not run paid provider calls, credentialed API calls, live crawls with material cost, or external mutations without the applicable approval gate.
Do not store secrets in .agents, harness, root docs, tracked manifests, or generated reports.

Do not publish, edit live CMS state, generate schema into production, submit IndexNow, change robots, change sitemaps, redirect URLs, or deploy code without the relevant mutation or production workflow.
Do not treat incomplete, capped, sampled, blocked, or missing evidence as a zero or an all-clear.
Do not let SEO content work bypass the writing discipline when the output is copy, article, metadata prose, or a content brief.
